title: An Act Related to the Issuance of Subpoena Power to Entities Created by Executive Order (TITLE CHANGE)

summary.text: This bill amends the laws governing legislative investigating committees to provide that when the Legislature delegates to a committee the power to administer oaths, issue subpoenas and take depositions, the Legislature has the sole authority to determine the membership and scope of that committee.
